_comment: Lira Solarpetal, Lumora's apothecary (Scripts/talking_vendor_npc.gd since 2026-09-24; Data/vendor_shop.json 'lumora_apothecary'). Warm, precise, a little too interested in what things are made of. Quest: Lira's Reagents. {word} in a line is a clickable keyword. ALL LINES ARE DRAFTS.
greeting: Welcome to my little shop. Mind the jars; some of them bite.
Lira Solarpetal. Potions, brews, and the kits to make your own.
Hello again! Anything poisoned, bitten or merely tired?
shop_intro: Alchemy and brewing both. Crystal vials are by the door.
Every recipe I sell, I've made a hundred times. Most of them twice as many.
ambient: Sandroot, thistle, a little cactus. Half the cures in the desert start with the same three things.
A caravan guard came in green this morning. Vipers. He'll live.
wrong_item: Lira sniffs it. "Not for me, I'm afraid."

sequence: I'm out of the rarer things. Scarab eyes, the glands bats see with, and slime gel. Nobody sells them; somebody has to go and get them.
Five eyes, three glands, four gel. I'll teach you the antidote I make for the caravans.

lines: Five scarab eyes, three echolocation glands, four slime gel. Fresh, if you can.
Oh, scarab eyes! Let me have those.
Hello! You look like someone who goes where the interesting {reagents} are.
